---
title: "Run the analysis"
---

From the repo root, install Matplotlib in your Python environment and run the example.

```bash
python3 -m pip install "matplotlib>=3.7"
python3 scripts/python/run_workflow.py data/metagenomics/example results/metagenomics/example
```

## Your task — Run your own study

```bash
python3 scripts/python/run_workflow.py data/metagenomics/my-study results/metagenomics/my-study
```

Choose a fresh output folder for each run. Open the five TSVs and the three PNGs in the run’s `figures/` subdirectory.

[Next: Verify and explain](05-verify-and-explain.qmd).
